name: loop-demo
description: Hardware-free demo of the `loop` primitive (iteration-owner model). `cycle` owns the loop: its mode is `forever`, so when the folder source runs out of frames the loop rewinds it and plays again — there is no `loop:true` flag on the source anymore, iteration lives in one place. The pipeline's tail closes the cycle back to the loop with a plain node-level edge: `save -> cycle` (by id, no port — it moves no value). Data flows forward as a strict DAG (cam -> save). Two kinds of live editing from the CLI (tab/enter/type): `threshold` is a `value` node that lands next cycle with no restart, and `cam.frameIntervalMs` is a MODULE binding — editing it re-activates the source with the new interval (it restarts at frame 0). Press SPACE to pause/resume (state kept, workers warm — pause is not cancel). Run it with: execute-graph --package packages/loop-demo --max-cycles 200
